note: Mutants of Shift with a finger for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the game reads Shift from SDL's modifier state at the left release only (src/ants_app/hud_pointer.cpp, hud_input.cpp: the Shift tap that adds or removes an ant, the Shift drag that adds the ants in the box and makes a group of one) against the Shift group of tests/test_app/test_touch_app.cpp, which sets the modifier state itself the way the page's Shift button makes it (web/touch_keys.js, docs/TOUCH.md). Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/touch_shift_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 900. Every mutant must be caught.
